test_two_tower_forward: test the TwoTower model forward pass with two independent LateFusion towers and a concat fusion module
test_shared_two_tower: test the TwoTower model with a shared tower and channel mapping between tower inputs
test_two_tower_torchscript: test that the TwoTower model can be compiled with torch.jit.script for both standard and shared tower configs
build_two_tower_model: build a TwoTower model using LateFusion towers with ConcatFusionModule and a custom concat tower fusion
review_twotower_architecture: review the TwoTower class and its shared_tower_id_to_channel_mapping parameter for multimodal late fusion
